summary: Examples of the url lookup: looping over lines, fetching JSON without line splitting, using username/password, forcing basic auth, and sending custom headers.
questions: How do I loop over each line returned by a URL?
How do I fetch a JSON document from a URL as one string?
What does a url lookup with basic auth look like?
How do I pass headers as a dict in a url lookup call?

answer_card.title: url lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- debug: msg="{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://github.com/gremlin.keys', wantlist=True) }}"

- debug: msg="{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json', split_lines=False) }}"

- debug:
    msg: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://some.private.site.com/file.txt', username='bob', password='hunter2', force_basic_auth='True') }}"

- debug:
    msg: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://some.private.site.com/api/service', headers={'header1':'value1'}) }}"
```
